title: Defense Protocol · Team of Four
subtitle: Find teammates, then enter the game. This lobby does not join in-game rooms automatically.
codeHint: Game room codes are members-only. Match rooms expire after two hours.
emptyHint: Create a match room and wait for teammates, or refresh later.
joinedHint: Join only one room at a time. A host leaving closes the team.
loginHint: Use your RIIC account to join or create a team.
closeHint: Closing a room frees all members to match again.
createHint: Publish a four-player match room first. Add the game room code later; only members can see it.
lobbyHint: Choose a team and build your alliance
stepOneHint: Use the same server as your team
stepThreeHint: Copy the code and depart with four players
stepTwoHint: Quick match or create your team
preferencesNotSaved: Preferences apply, but cannot be saved on this device
preferenceHint: Server and difficulty limit candidates. Bond settings filter teams and prefer complementary teammates.
noMatchesHint: Change difficulty or server, or create your own team.
factionHint: Select 2–4 core bonds and any add-on bonds. Saved with your profile.
profileSaveHint: Saved to your account, visible to teammates
profileDescription: Choose your preferred bonds so teammates know your playstyle.
homeTipOne: Four players includes the host. Once full, the host can mark the team as started.
homeTipTwo: Set favorite factions in your profile so teammates can learn your preferences.
homeTipThree: Only members can view room codes. Difficulty and server filters also apply to quick matching.
protocolHint_ac1: Lower enemy attack · Mild combat conditions
protocolHint_ac2: Higher enemy attack · More available alliances
protocolHint_ac3: Extreme enemy attack · More dangerous enemies
protocolHint_ac4: Maximum enemy attack · Extremely difficult conditions
protocolCreateHint: Wait for teammates to match in · Add game code later
profileMatchHint: Uses the current account’s saved core and add-on bonds. Updates when the profile changes.
customMatchHint: Local matchmaking preferences only. Your profile stays unchanged.
noMatchBondsHint: Your preferences need 2–4 core bonds before matching. Edit them first.
overlapMatchHint: Compares your preferences and every existing teammate pair. Shared core bonds weigh more. Overlap alone does not reject available rooms.
requiredBondsHint: At least one selected bond in each selected group. If both groups are selected, both must match. Empty means any. Your incoming bonds do not count.
matchDataHint: Compatibility estimates use declared preferences only, not owned operators, actual lineups or in-game bonuses. Missing preferences remain unknown.
bondMatchDescription: Use personal preferences to find a complementary four-player alliance.
matchFilterNote: Your own room always appears. Bond conditions apply to the lobby and quick matching.
joinCodeHint: Enter the match code to join. The game room code is shown after joining. Select the same server as the host.
joinExistingTeamHint: You already have a team. Leave it first or view it in the lobby.
protocolMatchBrief: Use saved bond preferences to find complementary teammates in a four-player team on the same server.
protocolMatchHint: Real player teams · Up to four members
waitingDescription: Four-player match room: members can view and copy the game room code, then prepare for departure.
waitingInviteHint: Copy match code to invite teammates
waitingStartedHint: Team marked started. Enter the game using the game room code.
waitingReadyHint: Waiting for all teammates to be ready
waitingCanStart: All players ready. The host can start.
waitingLeaveHost: You are the creator. Leaving dissolves this alliance and returns everyone to the lobby.
waitingLeaveMember: Leave this team to match again or join another alliance.
waitingRoomEnded: This alliance ended or expired. Returned to the lobby.
coreSelectionRequired: Choose 2–4 core bonds in your profile or custom match preferences.
coreSelectionHint: Select 2–4 core bonds. Add-on bonds do not count toward this limit.
waitingBondReadOnly: View this teammate’s core and add-on preferences. This view does not edit their profile.
roomCodeOptional: Game room code (can be added later)
gameCodeLater: Leave empty until the game room is created
gameCodePending: Waiting for the host to share a game room code
gameCodeVisibility: Only members can see this. Host updates sync to all teammates.
waitingGameCodeRequired: Waiting for the host to provide a game room code
protocolCreateBrief: Create a four-player matching room and share the game room code after teammates join.
portraitHint: Choose your favorite operator illustration. Save it to your profile for teammates to see in the waiting room.
portraitSearchPlaceholder: Operator name, pinyin or initials, e.g. amiya / amy
portraitNoResults: No operators found. Try another name or pinyin.
